text:
sasha: Kickoff for 'LaunchPad' Objective: tiny OSS refapp (chat + semantic search), concise tutorial, reproducible benchmark kit, 30-min webinar (demo + Q), gated 'LaunchPad Playbook' for inbound. Target: 900 dev signups, 180 live attendees.

finn: Nice. Dates?

sasha: Publish June 10, webinar June 24. Drafts by May 20.

meera: Bench plan: runs on cpu, small-gpu, and 4-bit quantized. I'll produce p50/p95, tokens/sec, and $/1k tokens. Need canonical prompt set (support convo, long-doc summary trimmed to 512, and short embedding queries).

owen: Repo scope: two services (api + static demo), docker-compose, one-click deploy badge, minimal README with quickstart and expected metrics. Keep code snippets under 12 lines.

finn: Webinar format idea: 7-min recorded demo, 10-min bench walkthrough with plotted comparisons, 8-min live Q. Also a 30s promo clip for socials.

sasha: Messaging angle: "forkable starter for production inference". Secondary: "benchmarks you can reproduce in your environment." Avoid hype.

meera: I'll publish raw CSV and a short methods appendix showing commands, hardware, docker tags so it's reproducible. Bench runs May 28-Jun 2.

owen: Lead capture: gated PDF playbook. Form fields: name, email, company, role, checkbox "Interested in Dedicated" to route to AEs. Add UTMs: campaign=launchpad, source=(webinar|blog|tweet).

finn: Social plan: 5-tweet thread, short demo gif, LinkedIn post, and newsletter shots. Draft copy by May 15.

sasha: Owners: sasha (launch owner), owen (repo+deploy), meera (bench), finn (content+social).

launch-bot: Checklist created: https://ok.redwood/launch/launchpad (repo, tutorial, bench csv, slides, gated playbook, form).

meera: Add a 'how to cost-optimize' callout: quantize, KV caching, batching thresholds. I'll include quantized numbers and recommended cache TTL.

owen: I'll add a GH Action to run a smoke bench on PRs and a CONTRIBUTING.md to accept community bench PRs.

finn: Draft headline options: 
- "Fork LaunchPad: a tiny starter for production LLM inference"
- "LaunchPad: reproducible benchmarks + starter refapp"

sasha: +1 first. Also prepare one-sentence TL;DR for social with one emoji.

meera: Need the canonical dataset (FAQ + 4 docs) by May 1 so bench can be stable.

owen: I'll wire HubSpot form and the AE routing by May 10.

finn: Will prepare webinar slides and a short bench narrative for the blog. Please get approvals on messaging by May 22.

sasha: Next check-in May 6 11am PT. If anything slips, update here. :rocket:
